cards.subject: Kybella
cards.heading: How does Kybella break down fat under the chin?
title: How
Kybella
Breaks Down Fat
cards.alt: Kybella is deoxycholic acid injected under the chin; it breaks fat cell membranes and the body clears them

steps.label: Injected
steps.note: Deoxycholic acid into the fat pocket

steps.label: Cells break down
steps.note: The fat cell membrane is destroyed

steps.label: Cleared
steps.note: The body removes them over weeks

cards.alt: Kybella recovery: swelling starts in 24 hours, peaks days 2 to 4, settles by week 2, resolves by week 4

nodes.label: Peak swelling
nodes.note: Chin may look fuller than before
